<p>大家好 👋，我是 Moment，目前正在使用 Next.js、NestJS、LangChain 开发 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fxun082%2FDocFlow" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/xun082/DocFlow" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">DocFlow</a>。这是一个面向 AI 场景的协同文档平台，集成了基于 <code>Tiptap</code> 的富文本编辑、<code>NestJS</code> 后端服务、实时协作与智能化工作流等核心模块。</p>
<p>在这个项目的持续打磨过程中，我积累了不少实战经验，不只是 <code>Tiptap</code> 的深度定制、编辑器性能优化和协同方案设计，也包括前端工程化建设、React 源码理解以及复杂项目架构实践。</p>
<p>如果你对 AI 全栈开发、文档编辑器、前端工程化或者 React 源码相关内容感兴趣，欢迎添加我的微信 <code>yunmz777</code> 一起交流。觉得项目还不错的话，也欢迎给 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fxun082%2FDocFlow" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/xun082/DocFlow" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">DocFlow</a> 点个 star ⭐</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/47884e154df342178cb9303994316e31~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgTW9tZW50:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1777411601&amp;x-signature=VO%2BpGaa16upHSZbKYSF9F5eCwLo%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>完整的前端监控平台通常分成三块：采集与上报、整理与存储、展示与分析。本文只讲第一块，从 0 搭一个可运行的埋点 SDK，并把指标采集方式对齐到当前浏览器与 <code>Core Web Vitals</code> 的常见做法。</p>
<p>名字会影响记忆和传播。这里把 SDK 叫做"四维"，英文 <code>four-dimension</code>，简写 <code>FD</code>，寓意尽量用上帝视角看清页面里发生的事。下文用 TypeScript 写示例，便于类型即文档。</p>
<p>自研采集层还要提前想好几条边界：是否采集可能含个人信息的字段、是否对错误栈与 <code>URL</code> 做脱敏、是否在低端机做采样。这些决定往往比多写一个 <code>observer</code> 更影响能不能上线。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">整体结构</h2>
<p>采集侧可以拆成四件事：配置、缓存与上报策略、各类 <code>observer</code> 与事件钩子、统一入口类。数据流与模块边界可以对照下图来记，和下面 <code>Mermaid</code> 图表达的是同一条主线。</p>
<p>如下图所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/5422cd3b95eb422c98a8bc51cde458fe~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgTW9tZW50:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1777411601&amp;x-signature=xpA%2B8VuXzwoHDzsVU91DA9%2BLWAI%3D" alt="20260325075816" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>从页面事件到内存队列，再到空闲或离开时发往服务端的一整条链路。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/07d02b0f50134a4d87774a19226337c2~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgTW9tZW50:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1777411601&amp;x-signature=IpQGjNE5Vjt06KXvGTIaSCdFqJk%3D" alt="20260325080415" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">配置与入口类</h2>
<p>业务侧只需要改上报地址、应用标识等。配置对象建议可合并覆盖，避免散落魔法字符串。可预留 <code>release</code>、<code>environment</code> 字段，方便和后端版本聚类对齐。<code>userId</code> 若涉及合规，建议只传哈希后的业务 id，或默认不传，由登录域自行下发自洽标识。</p>
<p>在 <code>config.ts</code> 中集中维护默认值，并导出 <code>setConfig</code>，便于在业务入口覆盖：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">MonitorConfig</span> {
  <span class="hljs-attr">reportUrl</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  <span class="hljs-attr">appId</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  userId?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  projectName?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  release?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>;
  environment?: <span class="hljs-string">"development"</span> | <span class="hljs-string">"staging"</span> | <span class="hljs-string">"production"</span>;
  sampleRate?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">config</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">MonitorConfig</span> = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">reportUrl</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"http://localhost:8000/report"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">appId</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"fd-example"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">projectName</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"fd-example"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">environment</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"development"</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">sampleRate</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
};

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">setConfig</span>(<span class="hljs-params">partial: Partial&lt;MonitorConfig&gt;</span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">assign</span>(config, partial);
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">Readonly</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">MonitorConfig</span>&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> config;
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>FourDimension</code> 负责在构造时拉起各模块。初始化不要依赖构造参数时，可以保持无参构造，只在 <code>init</code> 里注册监听，避免重复调用时重复挂钩子。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { initPerformance } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"./performance"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { initBehavior } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"./behavior"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { initError } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"./error"</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">class</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">FourDimension</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">private</span> inited = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>;

  <span class="hljs-title function_">init</span>(): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">inited</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">inited</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>;
    <span class="hljs-title function_">initPerformance</span>();
    <span class="hljs-title function_">initError</span>();
    <span class="hljs-title function_">initBehavior</span>();
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>业务里建议异步加载 SDK 脚本，初始化时 <code>new FourDimension().init()</code> 即可。若脚本可能被多次执行，务必保留类似 <code>inited</code> 的幂等守卫，否则 <code>fetch</code> 会被包一层又一层。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">上报通道 sendBeacon、图片打点与 XHR</h2>
<p><code>navigator.sendBeacon</code> 适合监控：异步、不抢主线程、在页面卸载时仍有机会发出。注意它发的是 <code>POST</code>，适合带 <code>Blob</code> 指定 <code>Content-Type</code>，而不是假设服务端只收 <code>GET</code> 查询串。</p>
<p>限制也要心里有数：无响应体、旧环境可能不存在、单次 payload 有实际上限（常见讨论量级在数十 KB，宜压 body 体积）。实践里常见优先级是 <code>sendBeacon</code> 优先，其次 <code>1x1</code> 图片 <code>GET</code>（数据需压缩且控制长度），再次带 <code>keepalive: true</code> 的 <code>fetch</code> 或 <code>XMLHttpRequest</code>。<code>sendBeacon</code> 返回 <code>false</code> 说明浏览器拒绝排队，应立刻换通道。</p>
<p>下面封装一个带降级的 <code>sendReport</code>。<code>sendBeacon</code> 分支用 <code>Blob</code> 传 <code>JSON</code>，图片分支再把数据塞进查询参数（注意浏览器对 URL 长度的限制）。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">isSupportSendBeacon</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> navigator !== <span class="hljs-string">"undefined"</span> &amp;&amp;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> navigator.<span class="hljs-property">sendBeacon</span> === <span class="hljs-string">"function"</span>
  );
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">reportImage</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, payload: <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> qs = <span class="hljs-built_in">encodeURIComponent</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>(payload));
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> img = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Image</span>();
  img.<span class="hljs-property">src</span> = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${url}</span>?reportData=<span class="hljs-subst">${qs}</span>`</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">reportWithXhr</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, body: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> xhr = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">XMLHttpRequest</span>();
  xhr.<span class="hljs-title function_">open</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"POST"</span>, url);
  xhr.<span class="hljs-title function_">setRequestHeader</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"Content-Type"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"application/json;charset=UTF-8"</span>);
  xhr.<span class="hljs-title function_">send</span>(body);
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sendReport</span>(<span class="hljs-params">url: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, body: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-title function_">isSupportSendBeacon</span>()) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> blob = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Blob</span>([body], { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"application/json"</span> });
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ok = navigator.<span class="hljs-title function_">sendBeacon</span>(url, blob);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (ok) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  }
  <span class="hljs-title function_">reportImage</span>(url, <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">parse</span>(body) <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<p>真实项目里可以在 <code>sendBeacon</code> 返回 <code>false</code> 时再尝试 <code>XHR</code>，把失败样本写入 <code>sessionStorage</code> 下次补发。接收端要核实：网关是否允许 <code>Content-Type: application/json</code> 的 <code>POST</code>，是否对 <code>OPTIONS</code> 预检放行，否则 <code>beacon</code> 在跨域场景会静默失败，需在 <code>Network</code> 面板核对状态码。</p>
<p>上报降级顺序若画成一张小抄，方便和运维对口径。</p>
<p>如下图所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/2f32f5a888604ceb99a02329b1f9e393~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgTW9tZW50:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1777411601&amp;x-signature=jtNWy27rHn%2BpXRVPB%2FhMmiRKJr4%3D" alt="20260325075931" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>三种通道的优先顺序与跨域核对点。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">缓存与上报时机</h2>
<p>目标是对主线程影响尽量小。常见组合是：</p>
<ul>
<li>内存里先攒一批，再批量上报</li>
<li>用 <code>requestIdleCallback</code> 在空闲时 flush，不支持时用 <code>setTimeout</code> 兜底</li>
<li>页面离开时把剩余队列一次性发出</li>
</ul>
<p>离开页面时优先依赖 <code>pagehide</code> 与 <code>visibilitychange</code>，比单纯 <code>beforeunload</code> 更稳，尤其在移动端后台化场景。<code>visibilitychange</code> 在标签隐藏时就能先 flush 一轮，<code>pagehide</code> 在真正离开时再做最后一跳。两个事件都可能触发 flush 时，要么在 <code>flushQueue</code> 内做"空队列直接返回"，要么加发送中锁，避免重复上报同一批。</p>
<p>从 <code>bfcache</code> 恢复的页面会再走 <code>pageshow</code>，<code>persisted</code> 为 <code>true</code> 时会话可能延续，停留时长统计要把可见时间分段累加，不能假设一次进页到一次离开。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">type</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ReportPayload</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Record</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">unknown</span>&gt;;

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">queue</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">ReportPayload</span>[] = [];
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">flushTimer</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">ReturnType</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>&gt; | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>(<span class="hljs-params">payload: ReportPayload</span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(payload);
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">flushQueue</span>(<span class="hljs-params">reportUrl: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, immediate = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!queue.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> batch = queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">splice</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, queue.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> body = <span class="hljs-title class_">JSON</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">stringify</span>({ batch });
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (immediate) {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">sendReport</span>(reportUrl, body);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">run</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; <span class="hljs-title function_">sendReport</span>(reportUrl, body);
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> requestIdleCallback === <span class="hljs-string">"function"</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">requestIdleCallback</span>(run, { <span class="hljs-attr">timeout</span>: <span class="hljs-number">3000</span> });
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(run, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
  }
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-params">reportUrl: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>, delayMs = <span class="hljs-number">2000</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (flushTimer) <span class="hljs-built_in">clearTimeout</span>(flushTimer);
  flushTimer = <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
    flushTimer = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
    <span class="hljs-title function_">flushQueue</span>(reportUrl, <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>);
  }, delayMs);
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">bindLifecycleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-params">reportUrl: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">onHide</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibilityState</span> === <span class="hljs-string">"hidden"</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">flushQueue</span>(reportUrl, <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);
    }
  };
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"pagehide"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">flushQueue</span>(reportUrl, <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>));
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"visibilitychange"</span>, onHide);
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>getCache</code> 若要对调用方返回快照，需要深拷贝避免外部改数组。深拷贝实现注意处理循环引用以外的普通 <code>JSON</code> 友好结构即可。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">性能指标用最新采集思路</h2>
<p><code>PerformanceObserver</code> 仍是采集绘制与布局类指标的主力，<code>buffered: true</code> 让你晚注入脚本也能拿到已经发生过的条目。导航类指标优先读 <code>PerformanceNavigationTiming</code>，比自己在事件里 <code>performance.now()</code> 更贴近浏览器统计。</p>
<p>在挂 <code>observer</code> 之前可以用静态方法探测当前环境到底支持哪些 <code>entryTypes</code>，避免 <code>observe</code> 直接抛错。下面是一段可放进工具模块的探测逻辑。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">supportedPerfTypes</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>[] {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">"function"</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> [];
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>.<span class="hljs-property">supportedEntryTypes</span> ?? [];
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">canObserve</span>(<span class="hljs-params"><span class="hljs-keyword">type</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">supportedPerfTypes</span>().<span class="hljs-title function_">includes</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">type</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<p>在 <code>Chrome DevTools</code> 的 <code>Performance</code> 或 <code>Lighthouse</code> 里跑一遍同页，把面板里的 <code>LCP</code>、<code>CLS</code> 与 SDK 打上去的值对比，数量级应一致。若差一个数量级，先查是否重复统计、是否在 <code>iframe</code> 里采集、是否混用了导航时间与绘制时间。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">与 <code>Core Web Vitals</code> 对齐</h3>
<p>截至 <code>Google</code> 面向站长的公开说明，<code>Core Web Vitals</code> 核心指标是 <code>LCP</code>、<code>INP</code>、<code>CLS</code>。<code>FID</code> 已被 <code>INP</code> 取代，自研 SDK 仍可同时上报 <code>FID</code> 做历史对比，但产品解读应以 <code>INP</code> 为主。</p>

























<table><thead><tr><th>指标</th><th>含义</th><th>推荐采集方式</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>LCP</code></td><td>视口内最大内容绘制完成时刻</td><td><code>PerformanceObserver</code>，<code>type: 'largest-contentful-paint'</code>，通常取最后一次有效条目</td></tr><tr><td><code>INP</code></td><td>交互到下一帧绘制的延迟分布</td><td><code>PerformanceObserver</code>，<code>type: 'interaction'</code>（需较新 <code>Chromium</code>），或引入 <code>web-vitals</code> 库</td></tr><tr><td><code>CLS</code></td><td>累计布局偏移</td><td><code>PerformanceObserver</code>，<code>type: 'layout-shift'</code>，且只统计 <code>hadRecentInput === false</code> 的条目并累加 <code>value</code></td></tr></tbody></table>
<p><code>FP</code> 与 <code>FCP</code> 仍可通过 <code>type: 'paint'</code> 观察，用于诊断首屏是否"空刷背景"与"首现有意义内容"的差异。</p>
<p>三个核心指标与采集入口的关系，适合印在团队 wiki 首页当速查图。</p>
<p>如下图所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/eaf6e90ffbe34673ac17c4d9713df94e~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgTW9tZW50:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1777411601&amp;x-signature=gJI3BEw6OQNBYuw5gU71tOb%2Bc2E%3D" alt="20260325080035" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><code>LCP</code>、<code>INP</code>、<code>CLS</code> 与对应 <code>observer</code> 类型名称的对应关系。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">paint 与首屏绘制</h3>
<p>下面示例合并监听 <code>first-paint</code> 与 <code>first-contentful-paint</code>，并在拿到 <code>FCP</code> 后断开，避免重复回调。若你希望两种 <code>paint</code> 都上报，应在两种都见到后再 <code>disconnect</code>，或干脆不断开、由服务端按 <code>paintName</code> 去重。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { enqueue, scheduleFlush } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"./queue"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { getConfig } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"./config"</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">safeObserverSupported</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">"undefined"</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">observePaint</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-title function_">safeObserverSupported</span>()) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> obs = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">list</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> entry <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> list.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>()) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (
        entry.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">"first-paint"</span> &amp;&amp;
        entry.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">"first-contentful-paint"</span>
      )
        <span class="hljs-keyword">continue</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> json = entry.<span class="hljs-title function_">toJSON</span>();
      <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"performance"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"paint"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">paintName</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">startTime</span>: json.<span class="hljs-property">startTime</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
      });
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (entry.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> === <span class="hljs-string">"first-contentful-paint"</span>) {
        obs.<span class="hljs-title function_">disconnect</span>();
        <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">break</span>;
      }
    }
  });
  obs.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"paint"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">buffered</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>LCP</code> 在页面生命周期内可能更新，规范语义是"最后一个汇报的 <code>LCP</code> 条目代表当前候选"。简单实现可以在回调里每次都上报最新一条，由服务端取同会话最后一次，或在客户端只保留最大 <code>startTime</code> 的那条再上报。注意 <code>LCP</code> 回调触发时 <code>entry.element</code> 可能已被移除，DOM 引用要谨慎，上报 <code>tagName</code> 与资源 <code>URL</code> 即可。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">observeLcp</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-title function_">safeObserverSupported</span>()) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> obs = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">list</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> entries = list.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>() <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceEntry</span>[];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> last = entries[entries.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>] <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">LargestContentfulPaint</span> &amp;
      <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceEntry</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> json = last.<span class="hljs-title function_">toJSON</span>();
    <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"performance"</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"lcp"</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">startTime</span>: json.<span class="hljs-property">startTime</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">element</span>: last.<span class="hljs-property">element</span>?.<span class="hljs-property">tagName</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">url</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"url"</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> last ? <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>((last <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> { url?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> }).<span class="hljs-property">url</span> ?? <span class="hljs-string">""</span>) : <span class="hljs-string">""</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
    });
    <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
  });
  obs.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"largest-contentful-paint"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">buffered</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
}
</code></pre>
<p>上面用到 <code>LargestContentfulPaint</code> 时，若项目 <code>lib.dom</code> 较旧，可把 <code>last</code> 标成 <code>PerformanceEntry</code> 并谨慎读取可选字段。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-7"><code>CLS</code> 与 <code>INP</code></h3>
<p><code>CLS</code> 需要过滤用户操作附近的偏移，避免把有意交互造成的布局变化算成体验问题。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">observeCls</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-title function_">safeObserverSupported</span>()) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> clsScore = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> obs = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">list</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> entry <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> list.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>() <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceEntry</span>[]) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ls = entry <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">LayoutShift</span> &amp; {
        hadRecentInput?: <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span>;
        value?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>;
      };
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (ls.<span class="hljs-property">hadRecentInput</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">continue</span>;
      clsScore += ls.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> ?? <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
      <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"performance"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"cls"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: ls.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">cumulativeLayoutShift</span>: clsScore,
        <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
      });
    }
    <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
  });
  obs.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"layout-shift"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">buffered</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>INP</code> 依赖 <code>type: 'interaction'</code> 的 <code>PerformanceObserver</code>，浏览器支持面仍在演进。生产环境若要省心，可直接使用 <code>web-vitals</code> 包，它会在不支持时降级或给出兼容策略。最小接入示意如下，真实项目里把 <code>console.log</code> 换成 <code>enqueue</code> 即可。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { onINP } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"web-vitals"</span>;

<span class="hljs-title function_">onINP</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">metric</span>) =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> v = metric.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>;
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"INP ms"</span>, v);
});
</code></pre>
<p>自研最小实现可以封装为"支持则订阅，不支持则不上报"，避免把未定义行为写死进业务。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">导航时间与 <code>DOMContentLoaded</code>、<code>load</code></h3>
<p>更稳的做法是读取 <code>performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0]</code>，得到 <code>PerformanceNavigationTiming</code>，用相对 <code>fetchStart</code> 或 <code>startTime</code> 的各阶段时刻算 <code>DNS</code>、<code>TCP</code>、<code>TTFB</code>、<code>DOM</code> 解析等。字段含义以 <code>MDN</code> 上的 <code>PerformanceNavigationTiming</code> 为准，换公式前用一次 <code>console.table</code> 把 <code>nav</code> 打出来核对。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">collectNavigationTiming</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [nav] = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntriesByType</span>(
    <span class="hljs-string">"navigation"</span>,
  ) <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceNavigationTiming</span>[];
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!nav) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"performance"</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"navigation"</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">dns</span>: nav.<span class="hljs-property">domainLookupEnd</span> - nav.<span class="hljs-property">domainLookupStart</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">tcp</span>: nav.<span class="hljs-property">connectEnd</span> - nav.<span class="hljs-property">connectStart</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">ttfb</span>: nav.<span class="hljs-property">responseStart</span> - nav.<span class="hljs-property">requestStart</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">domContentLoaded</span>: nav.<span class="hljs-property">domContentLoadedEventEnd</span> - nav.<span class="hljs-property">fetchStart</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">load</span>: nav.<span class="hljs-property">loadEventEnd</span> - nav.<span class="hljs-property">fetchStart</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
  });
  <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
}
</code></pre>
<p>可在 <code>load</code> 事件触发后再调用一次，确保 <code>loadEventEnd</code> 已非 0。单页应用在客户端路由切换时不会产生新的 <code>navigation</code> 条目，若要监控"软导航"，需要结合框架路由钩子或 <code>Performance API</code> 里仍在演进的软导航相关能力单独设计，不能把 <code>PV</code> 和导航耗时混在一条 <code>navigation</code> 记录里硬解释。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">资源耗时</h3>
<p>资源条目用 <code>type: 'resource'</code>。注意不要在每个 <code>entry</code> 上都 <code>disconnect</code>，否则只会收到第一条资源。更合理的是页面 <code>load</code> 后一次性读取 <code>performance.getEntriesByType('resource')</code>，或长期观察但在 <code>disconnect</code> 前处理完整批次。</p>
<p>跨域资源若没有正确的 <code>Timing-Allow-Origin</code>，多数细粒度时长在浏览器里会被抹成 0，这是安全策略不是 <code>SDK</code> 坏了。核实方式是对比同源静态资源与 <code>CDN</code> 资源的 <code>transferSize</code>、<code>domainLookupStart</code> 等是否突然全 0。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">observeResources</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-title function_">safeObserverSupported</span>()) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> obs = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceObserver</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">list</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> entry <span class="hljs-keyword">of</span> list.<span class="hljs-title function_">getEntries</span>() <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">PerformanceResourceTiming</span>[]) {
      <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"performance"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"resource"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">name</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">name</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">initiatorType</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">initiatorType</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">duration</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">duration</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">dns</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">domainLookupEnd</span> - entry.<span class="hljs-property">domainLookupStart</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">tcp</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">connectEnd</span> - entry.<span class="hljs-property">connectStart</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">ttfb</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">responseStart</span> - entry.<span class="hljs-property">requestStart</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">protocol</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">nextHopProtocol</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">transferSize</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">transferSize</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">encodedBodySize</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">encodedBodySize</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">decodedBodySize</span>: entry.<span class="hljs-property">decodedBodySize</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
      });
    }
    <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
  });
  obs.<span class="hljs-title function_">observe</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"resource"</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">buffered</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> });
}
</code></pre>
<p>若担心资源量过大，可在客户端按域名白名单或按耗时阈值过滤后再入队。也可按 <code>config.sampleRate</code> 随机丢弃非错误样本，只保留长尾。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-10">接口耗时：<code>fetch</code> 与 <code>XHR</code></h3>
<p>只劫持 <code>XMLHttpRequest</code> 会漏掉现代代码里大量的 <code>fetch</code>。可以同时包装 <code>window.fetch</code> 与 <code>XMLHttpRequest.prototype</code>。包装 <code>fetch</code> 时不要假设调用方不克隆 <code>Response</code> 去读体，监控侧只读 <code>status</code> 与头即可，避免和消费方抢读同一个 <code>body</code> 流。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">patchFetch</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> orig = <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">fetch</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">bind</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-property">fetch</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-attr">input</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">RequestInfo</span> | <span class="hljs-variable constant_">URL</span>, init?: <span class="hljs-title class_">RequestInit</span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> start = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> req = input <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Request</span> ? input : <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Request</span>(input, init);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">orig</span>(req);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> end = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();
      <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"performance"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"fetch"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">url</span>: req.<span class="hljs-property">url</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">method</span>: req.<span class="hljs-property">method</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">status</span>: res.<span class="hljs-property">status</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">duration</span>: end - start,
        <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
      });
      <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> res;
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> end = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();
      <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"error"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"fetch"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">url</span>: req.<span class="hljs-property">url</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">method</span>: req.<span class="hljs-property">method</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">duration</span>: end - start,
        <span class="hljs-attr">message</span>: err <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span> ? err.<span class="hljs-property">message</span> : <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(err),
        <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
      });
      <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> err;
    }
  };
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>XHR</code> 劫持仍可用 <code>open</code>、<code>send</code> 包装，在 <code>loadend</code> 上打点时间戳，与上文思路一致，此处不重复贴全。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-11">错误上报</h2>
<p>资源错误与 <code>JS</code> 运行时错误要分开通道。<code>window.addEventListener('error', …, true)</code> 在捕获阶段能拿到 <code>script</code>、<code>link</code>、<code>img</code> 等加载失败，<code>event.target</code> 指向元素。纯 <code>JS</code> 语法与运行时错误同一事件里 <code>target</code> 往往为空，可配合 <code>window.onerror</code> 或同一监听里分支处理。<code>ErrorEvent</code> 上的 <code>message</code> 在跨域脚本且未正确配置 <code>crossorigin</code> 时可能是统一口令，需要和源站 <code>CORS</code> 配置一起核实。</p>
<p><code>Promise</code> 未处理拒绝用 <code>unhandledrejection</code>。上报体里尽量带 <code>reason</code> 的栈信息，字符串化时注意大对象。</p>
<p>事件路径不要用已弃用的 <code>event.path</code>，改用 <code>event.composedPath()</code>。</p>
<p>错误从页面钻进队列前，按类型分流，便于后端路由到不同看板。</p>
<p>如下图所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/f46eaf8f281a411ca2f017a40ba2be62~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgTW9tZW50:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1777411601&amp;x-signature=O4x0aZnKT%2FluACbjryNDU1VuTJo%3D" alt="20260325080152" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>资源、脚本、<code>Promise</code> 三类错误进入同一条上报管道前的分流意象。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">elementPath</span>(<span class="hljs-params">ev: Event</span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>[] {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> path = <span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> ev.<span class="hljs-property">composedPath</span> === <span class="hljs-string">"function"</span> ? ev.<span class="hljs-title function_">composedPath</span>() : [];
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> path
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">filter</span>((n): n is <span class="hljs-title class_">Element</span> =&gt; n <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Element</span>)
    .<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">el</span>) =&gt;</span> el.<span class="hljs-property">tagName</span>);
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">initGlobalErrorHandlers</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(
    <span class="hljs-string">"error"</span>,
    <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">ev</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> t = ev.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (
        t &amp;&amp;
        t <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLElement</span> &amp;&amp;
        (t <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLImageElement</span> ||
          t <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLScriptElement</span> ||
          t <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLLinkElement</span>)
      ) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> url =
          <span class="hljs-string">"src"</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> t &amp;&amp; t.<span class="hljs-property">src</span> ? t.<span class="hljs-property">src</span> : <span class="hljs-string">"href"</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> t &amp;&amp; t.<span class="hljs-property">href</span> ? t.<span class="hljs-property">href</span> : <span class="hljs-string">""</span>;
        <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
          <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"error"</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"resource"</span>,
          url,
          <span class="hljs-attr">tag</span>: t.<span class="hljs-property">tagName</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">paths</span>: <span class="hljs-title function_">elementPath</span>(ev),
          <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
        });
        <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      }
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!ev.<span class="hljs-property">message</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"error"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"js"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">message</span>: ev.<span class="hljs-property">message</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">filename</span>: ev.<span class="hljs-property">filename</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">lineno</span>: ev.<span class="hljs-property">lineno</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">colno</span>: ev.<span class="hljs-property">colno</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">stack</span>: ev.<span class="hljs-property">error</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span> ? ev.<span class="hljs-property">error</span>.<span class="hljs-property">stack</span> : <span class="hljs-string">""</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
      });
      <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);

    <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
  );

  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"unhandledrejection"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">ev</span>) =&gt;</span> {

      <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"error"</span>,

<p>若担心第三方脚本堆栈污染，可在入口做采样或域名过滤。生产环境应上传 <code>source map</code> 到私有桶，由服务端按 <code>release</code> 解析栈，而不是把完整文件路径暴露给前端库。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-12">行为数据：<code>PV</code>、停留时长、点击</h2>
<p><code>PV</code> 在每次路由或首屏进入时打一条，带上 <code>document.referrer</code> 与本地生成的会话或设备标识。<code>UV</code> 必须在服务端用 <code>cookie</code>、登录 <code>id</code> 或可信指纹聚合，客户端只能提供匿名 id。单页应用要在路由变化时手动调一次 <code>reportPv</code>，仅依赖首屏加载会严重低估。</p>
<p>停留时长用 <code>visibilitychange</code> 记录可见累计时间，比只在 <code>beforeunload</code> 减一次更准，尤其是后台标签与 <code>bfcache</code> 场景。离开页面时再发一条汇总，字段里带 <code>visibleMs</code> 即可。下面是一段与队列解耦的计时思路，需与上文的 <code>enqueue</code>、<code>flushQueue</code>、<code>getConfig</code> 同模块配合使用。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { enqueue, flushQueue } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"./queue"</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { getConfig } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"./config"</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> visibleAccum = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> lastVisibleStart = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();

<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"visibilitychange"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> now = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>();
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibilityState</span> === <span class="hljs-string">"visible"</span>) {
    lastVisibleStart = now;
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
    visibleAccum += now - lastVisibleStart;
  }
});

<span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"pagehide"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">visibilityState</span> === <span class="hljs-string">"visible"</span>) {
    visibleAccum += performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() - lastVisibleStart;
  }
  <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"behavior"</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"dwell"</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">visibleMs</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">round</span>(visibleAccum),
    <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
  });
  <span class="hljs-title function_">flushQueue</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>, <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>);
});
</code></pre>
<p>点击监听建议防抖，避免长按或滑动误触暴风上报。坐标与 <code>outerHTML</code> 体积要限长，防止队列爆炸。敏感页面不要上传完整 <code>outerHTML</code>，可只保留 <code>data-</code> 业务埋点键名。</p>
<p>下面用 <code>sessionStorage</code> 存会话 <code>id</code>，首次访问时用 <code>crypto.randomUUID()</code> 生成。若需兼容极老环境，可再降级到时间戳加长随机串。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">createSessionId</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> crypto !== <span class="hljs-string">"undefined"</span> &amp;&amp; <span class="hljs-string">"randomUUID"</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> crypto) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> crypto.<span class="hljs-title function_">randomUUID</span>();
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-built_in">Date</span>.now()}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-built_in">Math</span>.random().toString(<span class="hljs-number">16</span>).slice(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>)}</span>`</span>;
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> sessionId = sessionStorage.<span class="hljs-title function_">getItem</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"fd_sid"</span>) ?? <span class="hljs-string">""</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!sessionId) {
  sessionId = <span class="hljs-title function_">createSessionId</span>();
  sessionStorage.<span class="hljs-title function_">setItem</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"fd_sid"</span>, sessionId);
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">reportPv</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"behavior"</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"pv"</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">referrer</span>: <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">referrer</span>,
    sessionId,
  });
  <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">reportClickDebounced</span>(<span class="hljs-params">delayMs = <span class="hljs-number">500</span></span>): <span class="hljs-built_in">void</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> <span class="hljs-attr">timer</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">ReturnType</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-keyword">typeof</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>&gt; | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">window</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">"pointerdown"</span>, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">ev</span>) =&gt;</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!(ev.<span class="hljs-property">target</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">instanceof</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Element</span>)) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (timer) <span class="hljs-built_in">clearTimeout</span>(timer);
    timer = <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
      timer = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> el = ev.<span class="hljs-property">target</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> r = el.<span class="hljs-title function_">getBoundingClientRect</span>();
      <span class="hljs-title function_">enqueue</span>({
        <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"behavior"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">subType</span>: <span class="hljs-string">"click"</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">tag</span>: el.<span class="hljs-property">tagName</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: r.<span class="hljs-property">left</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: r.<span class="hljs-property">top</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">paths</span>: <span class="hljs-title function_">elementPath</span>(ev),
        <span class="hljs-attr">pageURL</span>: location.<span class="hljs-property">href</span>,
        sessionId,
      });
      <span class="hljs-title function_">scheduleFlush</span>(<span class="hljs-title function_">getConfig</span>().<span class="hljs-property">reportUrl</span>);
    }, delayMs);
  });
}
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-13">上线前建议核对的一张表</h2>
<p>把下面几项当成发布前 <code>checklist</code>，在 <code>Chrome</code> 与一种目标内核（如 <code>Safari</code> 或内置浏览器）各测一遍。</p>



































<table><thead><tr><th>核对项</th><th>怎么核实</th><th>常见坑</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>sendBeacon</code> 是否到达</td><td><code>Network</code> 里看 <code>report</code> 请求体与状态码</td><td>跨域未放行 <code>POST</code>、<code>413</code> 体积过大</td></tr><tr><td><code>LCP</code> 是否合理</td><td><code>Lighthouse</code> 与 SDK 数值同页对比</td><td><code>iframe</code>、影子根、元素已移除</td></tr><tr><td>资源耗时是否全 0</td><td>挑一条 <code>CDN</code> 资源看 <code>responseStart</code></td><td>缺 <code>Timing-Allow-Origin</code></td></tr><tr><td>软导航 <code>PV</code></td><td>手动点路由后看是否产生新 <code>pv</code> 事件</td><td>只监听了首次 <code>load</code></td></tr><tr><td>重复 flush</td><td>快速切换标签看上报条数是否翻倍</td><td><code>visibility</code> 与 <code>pagehide</code> 未去重</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h2 data-id="heading-14">小结</h2>
<p>把上报做成"队列加空闲 flush 加离开兜底"，用 <code>sendBeacon</code> 携带 <code>JSON Blob</code>，性能侧用 <code>PerformanceObserver</code> 与 <code>PerformanceNavigationTiming</code> 对齐现代指标，并补上 <code>CLS</code>、<code>INP</code> 的采集意识，错误侧区分资源与脚本并改用 <code>composedPath</code>，行为侧把 <code>PV</code>、软导航与可见停留时间说清楚，就是一个可演进的最小监控采集层。存储与查询、告警与大盘属于下一篇文章。</p></div></div>
